messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] VB not yet in RStan?
parts:
We would like to have advi in Rstan but we still need to make sure it gives reasonable answers on a suite of examples. Currently there are issues with tuning so that it does not always give a good answer without hand-tuning, but we think this can be solved.
